275524889.description:
Title:
Mineral Study Kit Rocks Minerals Crystals Specimens Boxed Set Educational
Department:
Collectibles & Art
Country Of Origin:
United States
Description:
Unlock the wonders of geology with this comprehensive 2343 Mineral Study Kit and companion mineral sample set. The maroon box features 14 numbered mineral specimens organized in individual compartments, ideal for hands-on learning, identification, or collection. Paired with this is a second plastic display case containing labeled mineral samples from various regions (including Colorado, Oklahoma, New Mexico, and Spain), each cushioned for protection and clearly marked for easy reference. Both kits display a variety of textures, colors, and crystal forms, making them perfect for educational use, beginners, or collectors. Durable cases ensure minerals remain organized and safe, while the detailed labeling supports accurate study and comparison. Enhance your understanding of minerals, rocks, and geology with these practical and visually engaging study tools. Suitable for classroom, at-home learning, or as an addition to any mineral collection.

Artist Unknown
Profile of Man Smoking Pipe
Hand-Carved Wood Relief Plaque
13" x 9" x 1.5"
Unsigned
This expressive hand-carved wooden relief plaque depicts a man in profile smoking a long-stemmed pipe. Executed in a traditional folk art style, the piece features intricate textural details in the hair and a stylized geometric pattern along the lower shoulder edge. The warm, rich brown tones and lustrous finish enhance the sculptural depth, showcasing skilled craftsmanship and mid-century ethnographic influence.
Deep relief carving creates a significant dimensional presence for wall display
Features an integrated metal hanging loop on the reverse side
Hand-finished surface highlights the natural grain and character of the wood
Condition:
Good vintage condition with minor surface wear consistent with age. A small, stable separation is present where the pipe stem meets the base, and there are minor inventory markings in white ink on the reverse. The wood remains structurally sound with a vibrant finish.
